limitations: Unindexed prior stochastic hypergraph matching results may cover the narrowed theorem; complete text of arxiv:2609.28308 was not accessible for a decisive full-manuscript comparison.
novelty_scope: The classical unique-request packing implication and two-copy coupon-collector window are credited; only the quantitative random-hyperedge transfer to optimal fair welfare is asserted as a best-of-knowledge contribution.
scientific_scope: Unit-supply indivisible goods; binary r-set complements, r fixed at least 2; complete no-payment allocation; n at least m; independent uniform demand types.
scientific_summary: A quantitative coupling between optimal complete envy-free welfare and the singleton-type count yields a Poisson law in the double-coupon-collector window.
title: Poisson crowd-out for complete envy-free allocations with fixed-size complementary demands
